title: Handbook Data Model + Registry Schema
brief: Design MachineHandbook interfaces, create MachineHandbookRegistry with CRUD, implement Zod schemas for 10 handbook section types (specs, spindle, axes, tooling, coolant, alarms, maintenance, parts, controller, safety).

units.title: Design MachineHandbook TypeScript interface with 10 section types (specs, spindle, axes, tooling, coolant, alarms, maintenance, parts, controller, safety)
Create MachineHandbookRegistry with CRUD + search + persistence + versioning
Create HandbookSectionSchema Zod schemas for all 10 section types with unit validation and cross-field constraints
Build sample handbook entry loader and validation test suite against all 10 schemas

exit_conditions: All 10 handbook section schemas compile with 0 TS errors
MachineHandbookRegistry CRUD operations pass unit tests
Sample handbook entry loads and validates against all 10 schemas
Registry persists to disk and survives restart round-trip
